Thanks again for taking time to set up a procurement / legal review for Redwood. We scheduled a 45-min walk-through for today to run through:

- Commercial terms and SLA highlights (latency/availability targets)
- Data handling and retention clauses
- Audit/logging & SOC2 scope

- Redwood_Procurement_Pkg_v2.pdf (overview + pricing)
- SLA_Draft_2025-10-28.docx (working draft with internal comments)

If your legal team has redlines, please attach them here ahead of the call so we can annotate. Proposed agenda is above; primary ask is to confirm the procurement playbook and next steps on signature.

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/meet/ACME-9123 (calendar invite already sent)

Best,

Marissa — apologies, we missed the scheduled slot this morning. Our VP pulled procurement into an urgent internal review, and the calendar conflict popped up late.

I attached our initial redlines so you and the legal team can get a head start: ACME_Redlines_v1.pdf. High-level points we care about:
- Data retention capped at 90 days for logs
- Audit access limited to scheduled windows
- Indemnity language needs clearer limits for third-party data processors
We want to reschedule for later this week if possible — ideally after our in-house counsel (Elaine) reviews these redlines. Can you send a couple of alternative times?

Thanks and sorry again for the inconvenience.

—Daniel

Thanks Daniel — no worries. Appreciate you sending the redlines. We can absolutely regroup. Proposed next steps:

1) Internal review: Lauren will review ACME_Redlines_v1.pdf and flag any items that require commercial escalation.
2) Prepare an annotated SLA: we’ll merge your comments into SLA_Draft_2025-10-28.docx and share a marked-up version prior to the call.
3) Reschedule a 45-minute call with procurement + one member of legal (Elaine). Two options from our side:
   - Option A: Wed, 2025-11-05 @ 10:00 AM PT
   - Option B: Thu, 2025-11-06 @ 03:00 PM PT

Please confirm which option fits your team. Rishi / I will attend to cover contract terms and operational impact. Action items for the thread:
- ACME: confirm preferred time and whether Elaine will join (yes/no)
- Redwood: produce a one-page summary of redline impact and updated SLA before the call
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-9123 (I added a note with ACME_Redlines_v1.pdf)
We’ll aim to deliver the annotated SLA at least 24 hours before the rescheduled meeting.
Best,
--

Marissa / Rishi — Thu 11/06 @ 03:00 PM PT is confirmed on our side. Elaine (our counsel) will join; procurement team will be present as well. Two asks before the call:

1) Please send the annotated SLA and a one-page redlines-impact summary by end of day Wednesday (11/05). We need that in advance so our counsel can mark final points.
2) Confirm whether the SLA will reflect the 90-day log retention requested in our redlines, or whether Redwood will offer an alternative (e.g., 180 days with archived logs).

We appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll be prepared to escalate any unresolved indemnity language after the call.

Thanks,
